findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_search, web_fetch, web_screenshot, web_map, web_fetch_batch, web_feed, web_metadata, web_crawl, web_extract, web_act, web_crawl_async, web_extract_schema, web_diff, web_monitor_set, web_monitor_list, dev_trending · Private data: web_search, web_fetch, web_screenshot, web_map, web_fetch_batch, web_feed, web_metadata, web_crawl, web_monitor_set · Public sink: web_search, web_fetch, web_act, web_crawl_async, web_monitor_set, web_monitor_list · Destructive: web_monitor_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_search, web_fetch, web_screenshot, web_map, web_fetch_batch, web_feed, web_metadata, web_crawl, web_extract, web_act, web_crawl_async, web_extract_schema, web_diff, web_monitor_set, web_monitor_list, dev_trending · Private data: web_search, web_fetch, web_screenshot, web_map, web_fetch_batch, web_feed, web_metadata, web_crawl, web_monitor_set · Public sink: web_search, web_fetch, web_act, web_crawl_async, web_monitor_set, web_monitor_list · Destructive: web_monitor_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
